title: Submission-1 candidate selection — pre-registered rule applied, 2026-10-29 11:10 UTC
status: proposed to PI; not final until the PI confirms

inputs.five_fold_candidates: experiments/recipeA_analysis_20261028/hybrid_oof.json (members 46, 47; seed 48 enters once its fold1/2/3 runs exist — they were dropped, so the five-fold hybrid stays 2-seed; fold4-only checks use 3 seeds)

five_fold_oof_8954.best_candidate_by_protocol: B (equal-weight hybrid); C picks w=0.5 on four of five folds and is not better

rule_application.rule: preregistration_20261027 ensemble_vs_historical_rule as amended 2026-10-28: the candidate is the best five-fold OOF composition; it is submission 1 if not worse than the Phase-1 calibrated six on the matched rows
rule_application.candidate: B hybrid (0.5 recipe A seed-average TTA+scalars + 0.5 Phase-1 members)
rule_application.result: B is better than the Phase-1 six on the matched rows by 0.083-0.090 pp (95% CI excludes zero, P(better) 0.985-0.990) and better than recipe A alone on all five folds
rule_application.decision_proposed: submission 1 = hybrid B; the seed-only recipe A ensemble (A3) ties the Phase-1 six (+0.004 pp) and is NOT submitted alone
rule_application.open_choice_for_PI: hybrid partner = Phase-1 five (OOF available on all folds, 8.8052) or the submitted six (adds the SSL/raw sixth; 8.7977 on fold4, OOF only on folds 2-4). Recommendation: the six, because it is exactly the Phase-1 package already validated on the leaderboard (8.7010), and the hybrid weight is fixed at 0.5 either way.

what_the_submission_1_package_contains: Phase-1 six-member package unchanged (crop-based CPSAM members, 40 views each, fixed Phase-1 scalars)

recipe A full-data members: experiments/fulldata_recipeA_20261028/regression_std_s{46,47,48} (all-data SSL5 encoder, std pooling, terminal epoch 20), four-flip TTA, per-target scalars fitted on the full five-fold OOF: CD 0.9908 / CV 0.9869 / HEX 0.9930
equal-weight average of the two decoded vectors; no further calibration
T4 container on a CUDA 12.x base with memory-efficient SDPA asserted at start-up
green_track: hex6 HEX feature: -0.047 pp on recipe A alone, -0.029 pp on hybrid B (13 detectors) — below the 0.03 bar on the submission base; not included. Everything else negative. GPU 3 remains assigned to green until the PI decides.
limitations: Development folds reused for recipe selection; the hybrid weight was fixed a priori at 0.5 and confirmed by LOFO, but the decision to try hybrids followed a look at two-member results (recorded in the amendment)
Phase-1 members used validation-selected checkpoints; their OOF is optimistic, which favours the hybrid partner slightly
The 2-seed five-fold hybrid vs the 3-seed fold4 check differ in member count; fold4 numbers with 2 and 3 seeds agree within 0.001
